senses.gloss: Aduka, n. of a nāga king: Māy 〔247.27〕.

adūṣin, adj., in Divy printed aduṣin, prob. by error, doing no wrong (Skt. -dūṣin); in adūṣy-anapakārin (in Divy wrongly printed -anayakārin), doing no wrong and not offending: ˚kārī, n. sg. m., Divy 〔574.11〕; 〔581.18〕; MSV 〔i.215.13〕; ˚kāriṇo, n. pl., 〔ii.78.21〕.
Ādumā (Pali Ātumā), n. of a (Malla?) village: MPS 〔28.24〕 (Tib. a-du-ma).
